content: I can’t deduce the SMILES notation without any information about the compound. Could you please provide any available data for the sample—such as its molecular formula, ¹H NMR spectrum (chemical shifts, multiplicities, integration), ¹³C NMR data, IR peaks, mass‑spectrometry information, or a description of the functional groups present? With those details I can determine the structure and give you the correct SMILES string.
